Usage: envden [options] [command]

Encrypted whole-file env sync over your private network

Options:
  -V, --version             output the version number
  -h, --help                display help for command

Get started:
  setup [options]           Create a vault and configure this device
  join [options] <server>   Join using a pairing code or recovery kit in your
                            own terminal

Daily use:
  status [options]          Show what changed here, what's newer on the server
                            and what needs attention
  push [options]            Send your changes to the server
  pull [options]            Fetch and merge changes from your other devices
  diff [options]            Show changed key names without values
  resolve [options] [file]  Keep yours, take the server's, or finish an edited
                            conflict
  history [options] [file]  List the versions the server keeps, or restore one
                            as a local edit

Files:
  track [options] [path]    Scan, approve and link checkout env files
  untrack <path>            Stop tracking a checkout and restore regular env
                            files
  local-only <file>         Keep a managed file local to this checkout
  rm [options] <path>       Remove an env file everywhere on the next push
  alias <repo> <target>     Share another repo's env files, for example from a
                            fork

Devices and vault:
  device                    Add, list, rename and remove devices
  vault                     Re-key the vault, replace the recovery kit, or
                            change or reset the password
  server                    Move, switch or repair the server
  unlock                    Log in with your master password to restart the
                            unlock period

Maintenance:
  config [key] [values...]  Read or change settings
  doctor [options]          Check key files, symlinks, updates, Tailscale, HTTPS
                            and shell notices
  update [options]          Update envden through the method it was installed
                            with
  ui [options]              Open a local dashboard for this device
  agent                     Install the envden agent skill
  shell                     Manage the shell notice
  serve [options]           Run the server; ENVDEN_SETUP_TOKEN replaces the
                            setup token
  version                   Print the version

Commands:
  help [command]            display help for command

Usage: envden setup [options]

Create a vault and configure this device

Options:
  --yes                     Take defaults; secrets and checkout approval still
                            require your terminal
  --server <url>            Use this server
  --kit-out <file>          Write the recovery kit as JSON to a private file
                            instead of a PDF
  --name <name>             Device name
  --host-server             Run the envden server on this machine; no setup
                            token needed
  --setup-token <token>     Setup token, visible to other processes; use the
                            prompt in a terminal
  --telemetry <choice>      Anonymous telemetry (choices: "on", "off")
  --update-check <choice>   Daily update check (choices: "on", "off")
  --shell <shell>           Shell notice (choices: "zsh", "bash", "fish",
                            "powershell", "none")
  --agent <choice>          Install the agent skill (choices: "on", "off")
  --scan-root <path...>     Roots to scan for repos
  --exclude-root <path...>  Roots to skip
  --verbose                 List each repo and env file the scan skipped
  -h, --help                display help for command

Usage: envden join [options] <server>

Join using a pairing code or recovery kit in your own terminal

Arguments:
  server                   Server address, e.g. envden.your-tailnet.ts.net

Options:
  --recovery               Paste a recovery secret key and vault ID
  --recovery-kit <path>    Recovery kit path
  --name <name>            Device name
  --yes                    Use default preferences
  --telemetry <choice>     Anonymous telemetry (choices: "on", "off")
  --update-check <choice>  Daily update check (choices: "on", "off")
  --shell <shell>          Shell notice (choices: "zsh", "bash", "fish",
                           "powershell", "none")
  --agent <choice>         Install the agent skill (choices: "on", "off")
  --resume                 Finish a join that was approved while this command
                           wasn't running
  -h, --help               display help for command

Usage: envden status [options]

Show what changed here, what's newer on the server and what needs attention

Options:
  --json      Machine-readable status
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden push [options]

Send your changes to the server

Options:
  --json      Print the result as JSON
  --all       Sync all repos
  --yes       Confirm clean changes
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden pull [options]

Fetch and merge changes from your other devices

Options:
  --json      Print the result as JSON
  --all       Sync all repos
  --yes       Confirm clean changes
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden diff [options]

Show changed key names without values

Options:
  --json      Print the result as JSON
  --all       Include all repos
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden resolve [options] [file]

Keep yours, take the server's, or finish an edited conflict

Arguments:
  file           Conflicted env file

Options:
  --json         Print the result as JSON
  --list         List unresolved conflicts
  --repo <path>  Select a checkout
  --keep-mine    Keep your version
  --take-server  Take the server's version
  -h, --help     display help for command

Usage: envden history [options] [file]

List the versions the server keeps, or restore one as a local edit

Arguments:
  file                 Env file path

Options:
  --all                Include every tracked file
  --restore <version>  Write that version into the checkout without pushing
  --yes                Confirm the restore
  --json               Print the result as JSON
  -h, --help           display help for command

Usage: envden track [options] [path]

Scan, approve and link checkout env files

Arguments:
  path        Checkout or scan root (default: current directory)

Options:
  --copy      Place real copies instead of links
  --verbose   List each repo and env file the scan skipped
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden untrack [options] <path>

Stop tracking a checkout and restore regular env files

Arguments:
  path        Checkout root

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden local-only [options] <file>

Keep a managed file local to this checkout

Arguments:
  file        Managed env file in this checkout

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden rm [options] <path>

Remove an env file everywhere on the next push

Arguments:
  path        Env file path

Options:
  --yes       Confirm deletion, including local edits and conflicts
  --json      Print the result as JSON
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden alias [options] <repo> <target>

Share another repo's env files, for example from a fork

Arguments:
  repo        Repo ID to alias
  target      Repo ID whose env files it uses

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden device [options] [command]

Add, list, rename and remove devices

Options:
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  add                    Show a pairing code for a new device
  ls [options]           List devices and the version each last used
  rename <name>          Rename this device
  rm [options] <device>  Remove a device and re-key the vault so it can't read
                         new changes
  help [command]         display help for command

Usage: envden device add [options]

Show a pairing code for a new device

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden device ls [options]

List devices and the version each last used

Options:
  --json      Print the result as JSON
  --verbose   Include device ids
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden device rename [options] <name>

Rename this device

Arguments:
  name        New name, unique in the vault

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden device rm [options] <device>

Remove a device and re-key the vault so it can't read new changes

Arguments:
  device            Device name or ID

Options:
  --kit-out <file>  Write the new recovery kit as JSON to a private file instead
                    of a PDF
  --new-kit         Also replace the recovery kit as part of the removal
  -h, --help        display help for command

Usage: envden vault [options] [command]

Re-key the vault, replace the recovery kit, or change or reset the password

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  rotate          Re-key the vault so removed devices can't read new changes
  kit             Manage the recovery kit
  password        Change or reset the master password
  help [command]  display help for command

Usage: envden vault rotate [options]

Re-key the vault so removed devices can't read new changes

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden vault kit [options] [command]

Manage the recovery kit

Options:
  -h, --help         display help for command

Commands:
  replace [options]  Replace a lost kit; needs the master password
  help [command]     display help for command

Usage: envden vault kit replace [options]

Replace a lost kit; needs the master password

Options:
  --kit-out <file>  Write the new recovery kit as JSON to a private file instead
                    of a PDF
  -h, --help        display help for command

Usage: envden vault password [options] [command]

Change or reset the master password

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  change          Change the password; needs the old one and the kit
  reset           Reset a forgotten password with the kit
  help [command]  display help for command

Usage: envden vault password change [options]

Change the password; needs the old one and the kit

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden vault password reset [options]

Reset a forgotten password with the kit

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden server [options] [command]

Move, switch or repair the server

Options:
  -h, --help               display help for command

Commands:
  move [options] [server]  Move the vault to a new server
  switch <server>          Follow a signed move when the old server is
                           unreachable
  repair [options]         After a server restore, re-upload this device's data,
                           or finish the restore with --finish
  help [command]           display help for command

Usage: envden server move [options] [server]

Move the vault to a new server

Arguments:
  server                 Destination server address

Options:
  --setup-token <token>  Setup token, visible to other processes; use the prompt
                         in a terminal
  --resume               Resume an interrupted move
  --abort                Abort an unfinished move
  -h, --help             display help for command

Usage: envden server switch [options] <server>

Follow a signed move when the old server is unreachable

Arguments:
  server      Destination server address

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden server repair [options]

After a server restore, re-upload this device's data, or finish the restore with
--finish

Options:
  --repair-token <token>  Repair token; prefer stdin for upload, use a terminal
                          for --finish
  --finish                Check every device's upload and finish the restore
  --without <device...>   Drop unavailable devices; they rejoin as new devices
  --accept-lost           Accept the newest verified older version of a missing
                          file
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: envden unlock [options]

Log in with your master password to restart the unlock period

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden config [options] [key] [values...]

Read or change settings

Arguments:
  key         telemetry, update-check, agent-merge, auto-approve-worktrees,
              unlock-period, placement or env-files
  values      New value; placement takes a checkout path and link or copy

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden doctor [options]

Check key files, symlinks, updates, Tailscale, HTTPS and shell notices

Options:
  --json      Print the report as JSON
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden update [options]

Update envden through the method it was installed with

Options:
  --check         Check for a release without installing
  --post-install  Refresh installed integrations
  -h, --help      display help for command

Usage: envden ui [options]

Open a local dashboard for this device

Options:
  --port <port>  Port on 127.0.0.1 (default: random)
  --no-open      Print the link without opening a browser
  -h, --help     display help for command

Usage: envden agent [options] [command]

Install the envden agent skill

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  install         Install or refresh the agent skill
  help [command]  display help for command

Usage: envden agent install [options]

Install or refresh the agent skill

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden shell [options] [command]

Manage the shell notice

Options:
  -h, --help         display help for command

Commands:
  install [shell]    Add the out-of-sync notice to your shell config
  uninstall [shell]  Remove the out-of-sync notice from your shell config
  help [command]     display help for command

Usage: envden shell install [options] [shell]

Add the out-of-sync notice to your shell config

Arguments:
  shell       Shell; asks if omitted (choices: "zsh", "bash", "fish",
              "powershell")

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden shell uninstall [options] [shell]

Remove the out-of-sync notice from your shell config

Arguments:
  shell       Shell; asks if omitted (choices: "zsh", "bash", "fish",
              "powershell")

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: envden serve [options]

Run the server; ENVDEN_SETUP_TOKEN replaces the setup token

Options:
  --restored              Start a restored backup in repair-only mode
  --min-client <version>  Oldest client version to accept
  --data-dir <path>       Server data directory
  --port <port>           Localhost port
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: envden version [options]

Print the version

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
